items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I suppose Eubie Blake must have made some piano rolls and I wouldn't pay much attention to the label, as to who made the roll

ctx.x: Do you remember some of the music that you heard -- on the piano rolls, for instance, way back?

Some of the earlier piano rolls I heard were some by Fats Waller. I suppose Eubie Blake must have made some piano rolls and I wouldn't pay much attention to the label, as to who made the roll, but I do know that some of the songs were the popular songs of the day. "Avalon," "'Til We Meet Again," some of those early -- and then when the War was imminent, there was music like "The Drafting Blues," and things like that. And of course in the local five and ten -- Woolworth's or McCrory's, they always had a pianist…
